hooks.name: Session Start - Project Status
hooks.description: Reads the active cloud-dive plan at session start and prints a short status

action.prompt:
At the start of this session, read `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/tasks.md` (the active plan; `.kiro/specs/aeroicing-watch/tasks.md` is the completed baseline) and `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/submission-checklist.md`, then print a status of at most 15 lines so the agent knows where work stopped.

Count `- [x] N.M` and `- [ ] N.M` subtasks per top-level group 1 to 9. Output (plain text, no emoji):
Cloud Dive - Session Start Status
Progress: X / Y subtasks (N percent)
Days to deadline: days from today (UTC) to 2026-12-04 2 pm Pacific (Dec 5 07:00 KST)
Active group: first group with an open subtask
Next task: its first open subtask and a short description
Owner items open: open C items that only the owner can do (credits form due Dec 1 12:00 PT, blog, social, video upload, Devpost form)
Decisions: any of F1 to F6, D1 to D5 in `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/requirements.md` section 5 still unresolved
Usage log: number of rows in `docs/kiro-usage-log.md` (or "missing")
Remind that all remaining coding is done in Kiro only.
